comment: 32yo female, recently confirmed germline SDHA c.91C>T (p.Arg31Ter) pathogenic variant identified via multi-gene hereditary cancer panel after older brother diagnosed with abdominal paraganglioma at age 45. No personal cancer diagnosis; clinically asymptomatic with normal baseline plasma metanephrines + methoxytyramine (3-MT). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = SDHA carrier surveillance — biennial whole-body MRI from age 18-20 (already established baseline at proband-discovery age 32) + annual plasma free metanephrines + methoxytyramine + head + neck MRI q3y + abdominal MRI q2y for SDH-deficient GIST / RCC screening + cascade testing offer to parents (maternal vs paternal line — SDHA is non-imprinted, both at risk) and any future children; alternative = less-intensive symptom-driven track with biochemistry-only surveillance + cross-sectional imaging triggered by abnormal biochemistry / signs / symptoms (offered as shared-decision-making endpoint given SDHA's ~10-20% lifetime PPGL risk + adulthood-onset profile).
